title: SSL/TLS Certificates on a Plan: Early Renewal Credit for Web Hosting Plans
content:
**Billing desk note — certificates installed on a Web Hosting Plans plan and the early renewal amount**

The early renewal amount is reduced by a certificate bundle credit when one or more Harborline certificate subscriptions (SSL/TLS Certificates) in status active are installed on this plan: USD 12.00 when at least one of them is an OV or EV product, USD 6.00 when all of them are DV products; a plan with no active Harborline certificate installed on it receives no certificate bundle credit.

OV and EV products: Harborline OV Single Domain, Harborline OV Wildcard, Harborline EV Single Domain, Harborline EV Multi-Domain. DV products: Harborline DV Single Domain, Harborline DV Multi-Domain, Harborline DV Wildcard.

**Decision, in order of the products found on the plan's active installed certificates.**

1. Any OV or EV product among them: USD 12.00.
2. Otherwise, one or more installed and every one a DV product: USD 6.00.
3. No active Harborline certificate installed on the plan: no certificate bundle credit.

**Hypothetical plans.** An active Harborline EV Multi-Domain installed: USD 12.00. An active Harborline DV Single Domain only: USD 6.00. A Harborline OV Wildcard installed but no longer active, and nothing else: no credit.
